items.subject: Application | Special Education Teacher, Warif Academy | Amer AlSaaideh
items.htmlBody:
Dear Warif Academy Hiring Team,

I am Amer Abdeljalil, a special education specialist with an MA in Special Education (Excellent). I have over five years of experience with students with learning difficulties, autism and intellectual, hearing, visual and physical disabilities, and special education work in Qatar. Warif Academy serves students aged 3 to 21 with severe, complex and multiple learning difficulties.

  • Delivered specialised educational and therapeutic services in Qatar, with an individual programme for each student, as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Achieved full inclusion of students with disabilities for the first time in a government school.

I am applying for a Special Education Teacher or Learning Support role. My CV is attached.

Kind regards,

Amer Abdeljalil AlSaaideh
Special Education Specialist | Inclusive Education Coordinator
MA in Special Education (Excellent) | 5+ years in Jordan and Qatar
Phone / WhatsApp+962 78 018 9766
Emailamer.abdeljalil77@gmail.com

Available immediately | Open to relocation

items.subject: Application | Learning Support Teacher | Amer AlSaaideh
items.htmlBody:
Dear British School of Bahrain Hiring Team,

I am Amer Abdeljalil, a special education teacher and inclusive education coordinator with over five years in Jordanian Ministry of Education schools. I hold an MA in Special Education (Excellent), with a thesis evaluating resource rooms for students with learning difficulties. The British School of Bahrain is in Hamala and teaches students aged 3 to 18.

  • Managed the resource room and built an IEP for every student after formal and informal assessments.
  • Led training for general and inclusive education teachers, and hold a Cambridge Training of Trainers (TOT) certificate.

I am applying for a Learning Support Teacher or Inclusion Coordinator role. My CV is attached.

Kind regards,

Amer Abdeljalil AlSaaideh
Special Education Specialist | Inclusive Education Coordinator
MA in Special Education (Excellent) | 5+ years in Jordan and Qatar
